what: Uncertainty-aware dispatch (review roadmap: 'optimize outcomes rather than forecast scores alone', 'uncertainty and decision-aware dispatch'). Frozen in a commit before the policy is run on the test seeds.
finding_before: Matrix M20261113-150132 (a321fa5, identical episodes): the point forecast crossed dispatch_high = 6 within 1 s of the observed queue in 38 of 40 pairs. After the first trip both policies dispatch the moment the bus is available again, so only the first dispatch can move.
rule: predictive mode: request when predicted + margin >= dispatch_high for three consecutive valid forecasts (observed floor, re-arm, cooldown, one outstanding goal unchanged); escalation still clears on the point forecast; margin = quantile q of (truth - forecast) on the validation episodes of the installed model, used only while the forecast's model_id matches

choice_of_q.data: development seeds 101-120 of scenario S2 offline (simulator without ROS; before the first dispatch the queue depends only on arrivals); test seeds 1-20 not used
choice_of_q.criterion: the lead of the first dispatch over the observed queue should not exceed the time the bus needs from the request to the bay (about 30 s: DISPATCH_REQUESTED -> DOCKED in the a321fa5 runs), otherwise the bus arrives before the queue it was sent for
choice_of_q.decision: q = 0.8 (median lead 15 s, 18 of 20 <= 36 s); q = 0.9 has median 31 s and 8 of 20 above 40 s

test.seeds: 1-20 per scenario, paired with the reactive policy on identical episodes (common random numbers, checked per pair)
test.primary: S2 all-passenger wait (lower bound), paired delta predictive - reactive, 95 % whole-episode bootstrap interval
test.reporting: every result is reported as measured, whatever its sign; the point-forecast result of matrix M20261113-150132 stays in the report as the comparison
